objective: Find a robust paper-trading candidate for a $15 wallet without optimizing to a profit target.

constraints.funding: Include exact settled funding when applicable.

new_iteration.hypothesis: Decision-time volume/flow confirmation may suppress low-conviction 30-day long/cash TSMOM signals.
new_iteration.preregistered_rules: Completed candles; baseline 30-day long/cash TSMOM; 7-day dollar-volume percentile >= 50th; 20-candle up-volume share >= 55%; next-open fills; pessimistic intrabar ordering; no shorts; one position; DCA=0; base and stress costs; chronological folds; sealed final only after gates.
new_iteration.data_window: Not executed because exact reproducible public OHLCV and decision-time volume/flow data for the exact universe and matched dates was not available in the repository evidence set during this run.
new_iteration.reason: No synthetic or coarse substitute data was used; sealed final remained unopened. This is a data-integrity block, not a profitability result.

rejected_families: and all previously recorded rejected families in earlier ledger versions
research_rules: Test one genuinely distinct pre-registered family per iteration.
Use completed candles and next-open fills; never use future information.
Use development selection, chronological folds, cost stress and one sealed final evaluation.
Correct for multiple testing; never tune on the sealed final.
Reject a signal screen before execution code when raw cost-adjusted expectancy is negative or evidence gates fail.
Do not optimize to a requested monthly profit target or infer monthly profit from a small sample.
A pass permits paper validation only; live requires separate explicit approval.
next_queue: Keep admitted 30-day long/cash TSMOM forward paper settings frozen and collect real forward evidence.
Investigate basis/funding dislocation or another structurally distinct mechanism only when exact public decision-time data and current minimum filters can be reproduced.
Construct a portfolio ensemble only after a second independently admitted low-correlation edge exists.
